name: apple-notes
title: Apple Notes
description: Create, view, edit and render Markdown from on-device Apple Notes (macOS only).
author: tiagem

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Apple Notes
commands.description: Search, view and edit your on-device Apple Notes

commands.name: move-note
commands.title: Move Apple Note to folder
commands.description: Move an Apple Note to a different folder

commands.name: view-selected-note
commands.title: View Selected Apple Note
commands.description: View the currently selected note from Notes.app

commands.name: export-notes
commands.title: Export Apple Notes
commands.description: Export a folder of Apple Notes to Markdown files

commands.name: manage-templates
commands.title: Manage Apple Note Templates
commands.description: Create and edit your note templates

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Maximum Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of notes to load from the Notes database

preferences.name: defaultFolder

preferences.name: showListAfterCreate
preferences.title: Create behavior
